'''Version 0.9.6.1''' is the patch released on 17 November 2026, following [[Version 0.9.6.0]]. Its announcement covers Chinese characters, item-use popups and fuel-menu navigation. The wiki now shows values from [[Version 0.9.6.5]]; no separate 0.9.6.1 binary comparison was made.

== Changes ==
=== Chinese characters ===
More missing Chinese characters are added. The announcement does not identify this release's individual glyphs or their count.

== Fixes ==
=== Popups and fuel menus ===
Item Used popups update correctly.

The [[Fire|fuel menu]] scrolls with arrows or the mouse wheel instead of overstacking and expanding indefinitely to the right.

== Announcement ==
[https://steamstore-a.akamaihd.net/news/externalpost/steam_community_announcements/1849458702692481 Steam announcement], posted on 17 November 2026 (UTC). Source-only findings from the direct 0.9.5.6 to 0.9.6.5 comparison remain on [[Version 0.9.6.5]].
